name: milani-sangha-club
description: Club Management Platform — PWA for members, payments, events and administration

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix backend install --include=dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix frontend run lint:fix && npm --prefix backend run lint:fix
scripts.format: npm --prefix frontend run format && npm --prefix backend run format
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix frontend run format:check && npm --prefix backend run format:check
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test && npm --prefix backend run test
scripts.verify: npm run check:constants && npm run check:private && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:function && npm run check:bundle
